kind: Local exact-selected parser cache intermediate-storage microexperiment

reads.osPageCache: Warm after compression and verification; no cache eviction

limitations: Two fresh-process read samples per format on a powerful local host; limited variance evidence, no CI timing claim.
Compression has one sample per level, executed in fixed level1 then level6 order.
Storage wall time includes raw file reads, compression and temporary writes; accumulated gzip-call wall time is separately recorded.
Byte/SHA roundtrip verification is outside measured compression/storage timing.
Remote compiler archive is already compressed; intermediate byte reductions do not establish remote transport savings.
Source/schema unchanged; no builds or deployments executed.
Read samples cover cache-record I/O, optional gunzip and JSON.parse, retaining all parsed records; they exclude source Markdown hashing, link resolution and output emission.
The Node measurement runtime is v25.9.0; controlled CI previously used Node22/Bun1.4.2 and weaker hardware, so timings are not transferable.
recommendation: Do not ship without controlled CI copy/build comparisons. gzip1 is the better local tradeoff: about90.5% smaller storage, but roughly1.91s slower retained read+parse per edition; gzip6 saves another10.95MB but adds roughly1.60s read+parse over gzip1. Existing remote archives already gzip-compress parser entries.
